mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the heat–light link with rubbing was most worthwhile: an ordinary case showed why the initial explanation was too narrow.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial pairing of sunlight and flame was predictable, although it established a claim to test.

surprise.text: The moonlight comparison challenged a brightness–warmth link without implying that moonlight transfers no energy.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless; the printing step addressed a separate goal, though it was the only offered combination at that point.

continue.text: Yes. I would try another chapter for its concise use of counterexamples and its care in distinguishing a shared method from a replicated result.
